stations.title: Station 1: Laravel Installation & Setup
stations.desc: Install a XAMPP server to provide a local server with a MySQL database, and use the Composer package manager to download and install the Laravel framework.
stations.story:
👋 Welcome, future coding hero!

Let's dive into our interactive session for Laravel Installation & Setup!

🎯 Key Points Covered in this Session:
  • ⚙️ Configure the local environment and install Laravel: Install a XAMPP server to provide a local server with a MySQL database, and use the Composer package manager to download and install the Laravel framework.
  • 🚀 Running your first Laravel project: Create a new Laravel project and run the internal development server by calling simple commands.

💻 Starter Code Block - Running your first Laravel project:

composer create-project laravel/laravel my-web-app
cd my-web-app
php artisan serve

stations.title: Station 7: Database Schemas & Migrations
